companies.name: MiMARK
companies.description: MiMARK specializes in developing in vitro diagnostic solutions to improve the management of gynecological malignancies. The company envisions the gynecological fluid as the next step in liquid biopsy in gynecology. MiMARK's first objective is to improve endometrial cancer diagnosis.

companies.name: Sola Diagnostics
companies.description: Sola Diagnostics' WID-easy test is a non-invasive epigenetic solution for detecting endometrial cancer in women with abnormal uterine bleeding. Private equity investments totaling €3.4M and NIHR GBP 2.2M grant support market access.

companies.name: Madera Therapeutics
companies.description: Madera Therapeutics is advancing TR compounds that activate mitochondrial protease ClpP with activity across endometrial cancer and other drug-resistant solid tumors.
sources: NCI / CancerX — Madera Therapeutics platform (public listings)

companies.name: Xoft
companies.description: Xoft, Inc. develops electronic brachytherapy systems for radiation oncology including vaginal applicators used to treat endometrial cancer.

companies.name: Idoman
companies.description: Idoman operates in the wholesale industry, focusing on medical devices. The company manufactures and distributes the Thermablate Endometrial Ablation System, designed to adapt to various uterine cavity shapes and sizes. It also offers the Wing Needle for hysteroscopic procedures. Idoman serves as a distributor for these products, collaborating with authorized resellers to ensure their availability in different regions.

companies.name: Keytruda
companies.description: Keytruda develops and markets pembrolizumab, a monoclonal antibody immunotherapy used to treat a range of cancers. The drug targets the PD‑1 pathway to help T cells detect and attack tumor cells. It is indicated for non–small cell lung cancer, melanoma, head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, urothelial carcinoma, gastric and esophageal cancers, cervical cancer, renal cell carcinoma, endometrial carcinoma, cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma, triple‑negative breast cancer, and MSI‑H/dMMR solid tumors. Keytruda also provides patient education, treatment guides, and access support resources for people receiving the therapy.
sources: Merck — pembrolizumab FDA indications including endometrial carcinoma

companies.name: MIRFLOW LTD
companies.description: MIRFLOW develops a rapid blood-based genomic testing platform for early detection and recurrence monitoring of endometrial cancer. Funding from the EQT Foundation Women's Health Grant supports prototype validation.
sources: EQT Foundation Women's Health Grant — prototype validation

companies.name: Swift Biotechnology
companies.description: Swift is developing state of the art technologies that will save lives and save their health care system billions of dollars in unnecessary treatments made necessary due to late diagnosis. Swift is initially targeting development of screening modalities for endometrial and ovarian cancer. Their company is also pursuing plans for development of screens for other cancers and delivery systems which can transport treatment regimens by novel means in a site-specific manner. Swift Biotechnology is partnering with the University of South Alabama's Mitchell Cancer Institute, the premier cancer research facility on the Gulf Coast, and their offices are located on the premises.
sources: NIH grant — $1.1M early-detection research (Mitchell Cancer Institute)
Alabama Launchpad business plan competition winner

companies.name: Thermablate
companies.description: Thermablate is a fully-automated, portable medical device used to carry out global endometrial ablation (GEA). It helps treat pre-menopausal women suffering from heavy menstrual bleeding.
sources: Idoman Teoranta — Thermablate Endometrial Ablation System

companies.name: Utepreva
companies.description: Utepreva develops and commercializes single-use endometrial sampling devices for uterine cancer evaluation and early detection. The company focuses on the Utepreva Endometrial Sampler, a patented, FDA 510(k)-cleared device designed for rapid, in-office uterine tissue collection. The sampler combines suction, disruption, and absorption to retrieve both cellular and fluid-based samples suitable for diagnostic analysis. Utepreva targets clinicians and healthcare providers looking to integrate uterine sampling into routine clinical workflows without specialized equipment or operating room access. The company manufactures the device and works with distribution partners that manage national sales and deployment across clinical and healthcare networks. Its offerings are positioned for use in women's health and oncology diagnostics settings to address the lack of standardized screening approaches.
sources: PR Newswire — Utepreva Endometrial Sampler launch

companies.name: Celvia CC AS
companies.description: Celvia develops genetic tests and laboratory services focused on reproductive medicine, prenatal screening and food safety. The company offers assays such as NIPTIFY for non-invasive prenatal screening, beREADY for endometrial receptivity assessment and PGT-A testing to support in vitro fertilization decisions. Its portfolio also includes InvisibleMi tests for genital tract microbiome profiling and CLARITY testing for chromosomal causes of pregnancy loss. Celvia extends its molecular diagnostics expertise to food safety through honey metagenomic DNA analysis to characterize honey composition and detect adulteration. The organization conducts research and development projects that integrate genomics, bioinformatics and clinical collaboration to create science-based diagnostic solutions for patients, clinicians and businesses.

companies.name: Igenomix
companies.description: Igenomix provides reproductive genetic testing services focused on fertility, IVF, and prenatal care. The company operates as a research‑driven laboratory group that collaborates with IVF clinics and fertility doctors to develop genetics‑based tests that support all stages of the reproductive journey. Its portfolio includes preimplantation genetic testing such as PGT‑A, PGT‑M, PGT‑SR and related embryo assessment tools, endometrial receptivity and microbiome tests like ERA, EMMA, ALICE and EndomeTRIO, and non‑invasive embryo evaluation such as EMBRACE. Igenomix also offers carrier screening (CGT), sperm analysis tests (SAT), miscarriage analysis (POC), and non‑invasive prenatal screening tests like NACE. These services are designed for healthcare professionals and patients seeking to understand infertility causes, reduce genetic disease risk, and support healthy pregnancy outcomes.

companies.name: Normedi
companies.description: Normedi develops and distributes medical devices and consumables for gynecological surgery. The company focuses on minimally invasive solutions for hysteroscopy, endometrial ablation, laparoscopy, and colposcopy, including tissue removal systems, adhesion barriers, scopes, and fluid management equipment. Normedi supplies products such as NovaSure V5 endometrial ablation, the MyoSure tissue removal suite, Oxiplex adhesion barrier gels, and a range of instruments, optics, and accessories. It serves gynecologists, hospitals, and clinics by offering devices for office and operating-room procedures that address abnormal uterine bleeding, intrauterine pathologies, and adhesion prevention. Through Normedi Education, it also delivers training, clinical information, and procedure-focused resources for healthcare professionals in gynecology.
sources: Normedi product portfolio — NovaSure V5, MyoSure
